Book correction: The answer key prints \frac{2\pi}{3} for part (i). This is a misprint: the coefficient of x in \sin 5x is 5, so the period is \frac{2\pi}{5}. (2\pi/3 would be the period of \sin 3x.)

Book correction: The answer key prints \frac{40}{\pi} for part (v). This is wrong: 2\pi \div \frac{\pi}{20} = 40; the two \pi's cancel. Check: adding 40 to x adds \frac{\pi}{20} \times 40 = 2\pi to the angle, while adding \frac{40}{\pi} adds only 2 radians. The period is 40.
